Open Start and type your company name and your own limits in the yellow cells: days before a chase, the yearly cost of your own cash, the factoring fee you want to stay under and the days after which loads are put on hold.
Check Customers with their terms and credit limit, then the Factoring Rate Card with the phone and the fee steps of each provider.
Enter each invoice on Invoices the day the proof of delivery arrives. Days to invoice, days overdue, open amount, short amount, status and the chase flag fill in by themselves.
Put the charges of every invoice on Invoice Lines and watch the check against the invoice amount.
Record every payment on Payments Received; a payment without an invoice stays flagged as unmatched until you allocate it.
Write every invoice paid short on Short Pays with the reason, and note what is recovered later.
Record each invoice sold for an advance on Factoring Advances and each reserve paid back on Reserve Releases; Factoring Cost shows the cost per month.
Log every call about a late invoice on Collections Log with the date promised; a missed promise shows in red.
Keep Waiting for Documents and Unbilled Extras current so nothing waits to be invoiced.
Read Receivables Ageing, Credit Limit Use and Cash Expected every week, and keep Credit Checks and Quick-pay Offers up to date.
Use the 14 calculators before you decide: due date, days outstanding, factoring cost, factoring or waiting, credit room, late payer cost, quick-pay, short pay, bad debt, invoice total and more.
Read Receivables Dashboard and Charts every week: invoiced, cash received, ageing, days to pay, short pays and factoring.

Fuel purchases with price, discount and use
One row per fill: truck, driver, region, station, litres and price; the amount, net price, km since the last fill, litres per 100 km, cost per km and the network check fill in by themselves.
Weekly fuel card statements checked against your fills
One row per weekly statement from the fuel card provider; the amount net of the discount, the discount share and the gap to your own fills fill in, so a wrong price shows at once.
Fuel price per litre by month and region
The average pump price per litre in each region and month; the change on the previous month, the swing and an alert for a big rise fill in by themselves.
Fuel use per truck and month
Litres burned and km driven per truck and month; litres per 100 km against the rated figure, the fuel cost and the cost per km fill in by themselves.
Fuel use per driver and quarter
Litres burned and km driven per driver and quarter; litres per 100 km, the fleet average and the gap to it fill in, so the thirstiest driving style shows.
Km driven and litres bought by region and quarter
One row per truck, region and quarter: km driven there and litres bought there; the litres used at the fleet figure, the net litres and the tax in that region fill in by themselves.
Fuel tax return by region and quarter
One row per region and quarter; km and litres bought come from the Km and Litres sheet, litres used come from your fleet figure, and the net litres and the tax due or credit fill in.
One row per region and quarter with the due date, status and who filed it; the amount comes from the Fuel Tax Return sheet and the on-time check and the days to the due date fill in.
Fuel tax per litre and price index by region
The six regions with the demo fuel tax per litre and the price index against the central region; every fuel sheet picks the region from this list. Check your own rates.
Station price list with the gap to the region average
One row per station with the last price seen and whether the fuel card network includes it; the gap to the region average and the litres you bought there fill in by themselves.
Cheapest fuel region on each lane and the saving per fill
One row per lane with the regions it crosses and the cheapest one; the price there now and the saving per fill against the average price on the lane fill in from the price sheet.
Average price index on the lane
Bulk tank deliveries, issues and stock
Every delivery into the yard tank and every issue to a truck; the litres left, the average price of the stock and its value fill in, and a low stock is flagged.
Fuel card discount received against the discount due
One row per month with the discount the provider paid; the discount due on your network fills, the gap and the saving against the pump price fill in, so a missing discount shows.
Fuel surcharge billed against the fuel burned
One row per month with the revenue and the fuel surcharge you billed; the fuel cost, the extra cost above your base price and the share the surcharge recovered fill in from the fills.
Reefer unit fuel use per trailer and month
Hours the refrigeration unit ran and litres it burned per reefer trailer and month; litres per hour, the cost and a check against the figure you expect fill in.
One row per fill with no receipt: who asked, when it was found and the status; the truck, driver, amount, days open and the next step fill in from the Fuel Purchases sheet.
Fuel budget against actual per month
One row per month with the litres and price you planned; the planned cost, the actual litres and cost from your fills and the variance fill in, and the open month is marked.
Odometer readings with km since the previous reading
One row per truck reading with the source; the km and days since the previous reading, the km per day and a check for a reading that did not move fill in by themselves.
Trucks with the driver and rated fuel use
The eight trucks with their driver and the rated litres per 100 km; every fuel sheet picks the truck from this list and compares use with the rated figure.
The owner and seven drivers with the phone used by the message links; fuel sheets pick the driver from this list.
